title: (RHBA-2020:5180) Satellite 6.8.1 Async Bug Fix Update
portal_summary: Updated Satellite 6.8 packages that fix several bugs are now available for Red Hat Satellite.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Satellite|Red Hat Satellite Capsule|6.8|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For detailed instructions how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_satellite/6.8/html/upgrading_and_updating_red_hat_satellite/updating_satellite_server_capsule_server_and_content_hosts
portal_description:
Red Hat Satellite is a system management solution that allows organizations to configure and maintain their systems without the necessity to provide public Internet access to their servers or other client systems. It performs provisioning and configuration management of predefined standard operating environments.

This update fixes the following bugs:

1884018	When delete the hypervisor from satellite, the manifest will be broken
1884020	Unable to apply all Errata via Remote Execution on Web UI with "Select All"
1884024	Red Hat Satellite upgrade to 6.6 fails if duplicate permissions are present in foreman database
1884033	"Ansible report timeout" setting is ignored as report origin is not properly set
1890905	Last checkin date/time not update when hypervisor is checked in via virt-who
1890909	Remote Execution Capsules are not listed when querying the subnet using API and hammer.
1890912	No longer able to tag docker image using hammer after upgrading to Satellite 6.7/6.8
1890916	Pulp worker can consume high memory when publishing a repository with large metadata files
1892599	foreman-rake katello:reimport fails

Users of Red Hat Satellite are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs.
